_what: Words and shapes no sentence a person reads may contain, as DATA: the sign-in pages' words and the trillion command's words (tools/use-trillion-from-a-shell/do-work/trillion.json, `words`) are each checked against this one list by their own test. `words` match whole words, any case; `patterns` are regular expressions (flags `i`). Technical detail a person asks for with --verbose is not person-facing and is kept apart from these checks.
